numericalScope: 170 existing groups/fixtures completed in split invocations after a command timeout; 14 new optional-task/sampling/real-engine groups. All passed. Not a clinical validation.
transport: Production code and genuine uploaded WASM in Chromium; in-memory document/Blob worker URLs, asset-fetch transport substitution only. No simulated glare answers.
notTested: independent validation of arbitrary task-reference selection shapes
importantBehavior: Original fixed-threshold settings, including explicit legacy low-light ON, retained. Engine-default OFF is a deliberate button/checkbox choice.
Task mean = sum(L dOmega)/sum(dOmega) from calibrated native source pixels; no cosine. No B-minus-A subtraction.
Task scalar must exceed 100 cd/m2; lower thresholds rejected, not clamped or passed as a different -b mode.
No subjective severity classifier or optical glare-appearance simulation added.
